problemStatement.formal: Generalize square non-negativity from integers to arbitrary LinearOrderedSemiring and related ordered algebraic structures.
problemStatement.plain: Show that x*x is nonnegative in the weakest common ordered algebraic setting, then derive standard square-based consequences.
whyMatters: Demonstrates how Lean typeclasses expose the exact algebraic assumptions behind familiar inequalities
Turns the parent integer proof into reusable ordered-ring and ordered-field infrastructure

proven: Mathlib mul_self_nonneg proves 0 <= x*x in any LinearOrderedSemiring.
The result specializes to Nat, Int, Rat, and Real, and also has an independent LinearOrderedRing case-analysis proof.
Consequences include sum-of-squares nonnegativity, abs-square equality, and a two-variable AM-GM variant.
open: Clarify minimal partial-order assumptions beyond LinearOrderedSemiring.
Extend the AM-GM and Cauchy-Schwarz-style consequences to broader finite-family statements.
knownResults.goal: Record the verified generalization of square non-negativity.
